name: CVS (Partner)
desc:
Contact Center Service Advocate I (Oak Street Health, req R1055334) | $17.00 - $34.15/hr | Full-Time, Remote, Inbound and outbound calls, appointment scheduling, no sales expected
Company: CVS Health (Oak Street Health)
Industry: Customer Service

What a typical day will look like:
You are on the phone with patients of Oak Street Health, a primary care group that serves older adults. You schedule, reschedule, and cancel appointments, answer questions, and call patients back to confirm visits and give reminders. You enter patient and appointment details into the scheduling system and keep careful notes on every call. When a scheduling problem comes up, you work it out, and you check in with medical staff and other departments when needed. The goal is a smooth, friendly experience for every patient.

Soft Skills
- Warm, patient phone manner
- Attention to detail
- Multitasking and time management
- Problem solving
- Reliability and strong attendance

Details - 
Customer Service Situations: 7 Questions asking what you would be most and least likely to do.

Personality Questions: 39 standard questions.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent. Some undergraduate education preferred.
Required Experience: 1 year of customer service experience. Prior remote work experience.
Preferred Experience: Call center experience, EMR (Electronic Medical Record) documentation experience, and Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese, or Polish speakers.
Required Skills:
- Proficient PC skills, including basic Microsoft Excel and Google Suite
- Outstanding phone etiquette
- Multitasking and managing time well
- High speed internet hardwired to a router or modem
- A private, distraction-free workspace and reliable dependent care during work hours
- Able to join classroom-style remote training
- US work authorization

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has at least a year of customer service experience and has worked from home before
- Is kind and patient with older adults
- Likes steady, structured phone work with clear schedules
- Wants a path to Service Advocate II after 6 months

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has never worked remotely
- Cannot work an assigned schedule, which can include a weekend shift
- Does not have a private workspace or reliable dependent care during work hours
- Cannot hardwire their internet to a router or modem
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or emailed directly to you
3. If the assessment is passing, watch for an email or text from a recruiter for a phone screen
4. If the phone screen goes well, expect a final interview
This is an estimated process. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.

Top 10 resume keywords:
- Customer service
- Appointment scheduling
- Inbound and outbound calls
- Data entry
- Patient experience
- Problem resolution
- EMR documentation
- Phone etiquette
- Multitasking
- Remote work experience

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell me about your customer service experience.
- What has your experience been working from home, and how do you stay focused?
- Tell me about a time you helped an upset or confused customer. (PAR: Problem, Action, Result)
- Tell me about a time you caught a mistake and fixed it before it caused a problem. (PAR: Problem, Action, Result)
- How would you talk with an older patient who is nervous about scheduling a visit?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:

-Pay: $17.00 - $34.15/hr, as listed in the posting. The range is wide, so ask the recruiter where entry level pay lands.

-Shift: Full-time, 40 hours per week, assigned schedule that varies with business needs. The contact center is open 24/7, and some schedules may include one weekend shift.

-Benefits: Basic benefits: insurance options, PTO, possible 401k. The posting does not list benefits, so confirm with the recruiter.

-Equipment Provided: Yes. The company provides the equipment. You provide high speed internet and hardwire the equipment to your router or modem.

-Felony Friendly? Case by case.

-Drug Test: Certain positions.

-Notes: Remote role with classroom-style remote training, but the posting does not give the training length. Prior remote work experience is a requirement, so this fits someone who has already worked from home. You need a private, distraction-free workspace and reliable dependent care during work hours. If you live within 50 miles of an Oak Street Health location, you may need to provide your own transportation for occasional on-site support. The posting lists call center and home office locations in Downers Grove IL, Chicago IL, and Charlotte NC.

-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Contact Center Service Advocate I → Service Advocate II (after 6 months and 3 months of Exceptional metrics) → Senior Advocate or Team Lead → Contact Center Supervisor → Operations Manager.
